headline: Council approves energy contract financing, passes bills, refers water system purchase

meeting.summary: Members voted 9–0 to finance Phase 3 of an energy savings contract, and Bill 68 on West Maui parking passed first reading 9–0. Resolution 26-116 on water system assets went to the Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee.
meeting.recap: A council member opened by marking 128 years since the Newlands Resolution, which claimed to annex Hawaiʻi in 1898.[[0:02:39]] A testifier said a county housing program for kūpuna (elders) now houses 10 people in 8 units.[[0:43:00]] Members voted 9–0 to finance Phase 3 of an energy savings contract, up to $9,021,259 plus interest.[[1:26:20]] Bill 68, updating West Maui parking rules, passed first reading 9–0.[[2:34:47]] A council member proposed a charter change so the Director of Finance would receive injury and damage claims starting January 1, 2028.[[2:37:21]] The change passed 9–0.[[2:41:44]] Two resolutions seeking a state property-sale transparency bill passed 8–0, with one member excused.[[2:53:43]] Bill 84, capping bed and breakfast homes on Molokaʻi at five, passed 9–0.[[3:36:53]]
decided: The water system purchase resolution was referred to the Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee.
meeting.next: Charter amendment resolutions need two readings, so they return for a second reading. A council member will seek a state law change through the council's legislative package so claims handling can later be set by ordinance. The water purchase resolution goes to the budget committee, with presentations in committee.

issues.oneLine: A resolution authorizes buying a condo unit in Lahaina for up to $278,000.
issues.why: A testifier said over half of the program's 41 waitlisted households are still in FEMA housing.
issues.brief: A testifier said the kūpuna housing program now houses 10 people in 8 units.[[#1]] A county housing testifier said the unit would be bought with federal Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) funds.[[#2]] An amendment added the unit's appraisal report to the resolution.[[#3]]
